notes: 41 Eternal spell items in 22 spell lines (tiers I-IV; Entangle, Protective Barrier, Shock Totem, Shroud Beam and Shroud Meteor have one untiered item; Ball Lightning and Pillar Of Flames only a tier I), plus 11 Eternal arrows (category 'Eternal arrows', included because they share the system). Source: enshrouded.tools item pages, which are read from the 1.0 game files (site footer: 'Game data: Steam build 25936191', 'Out now - version 1.0'). The 22 level-45 spell items are the '22 tier-7' Eternal spells from the 1.0 notes. Eternal Light Burst I matches the user's 1.0 screenshot exactly, so it is confirmed-1.0; every other item is likely-1.0 (same datamined source, not checked in game). No second post-1.0 source with recipes exists yet: enshrouded.wiki.gg Spells (last edited 2026-06-16) and the guide sites are pre-1.0 (old names like 'Eternal Light Burst' lvl 22). 'school' is the game's 'Damage type' field. 'station' is the station the crafter needs nearby (null = crafter alone). 'Sheltered Bed' is confirmed only for the Alchemist (screenshot); for Collector/Hunter/Fisher it is inferred. Resource 'source' is enshrouded.tools' 'Where to get it' line, which matches the game's source line in the screenshot (Smelter, Charcoal Kiln, Kindlewastes, Springlands); where that line is missing, source is null (or the recipe's crafter, flagged sourceInferred). Resource recipes use the recipe matching that source line; alternatives are in otherRecipes. Craft times and quantities come from the site's recipe tables, which agree with its 1.0 recipe diff (e.g. Charcoal 17 wood -> 12, makes 15 -> 10); the site's prose 'About' blurbs still quote Early Access numbers, so ignore them. Water appears as an input with waterCharges: true (recipe-header 'N water charges', drawn from base water storage). renamedFrom and changes1_0 come from the enshrouded.tools 1.0 changelog (a diff against Early Access game data).
